Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell (Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/downstream ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (trigger) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/downstream/step/script step.script (the job has no steps; a no-op step keeps the workflow valid)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/downstream job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/downstream step.script: no-op step (Woodpecker needs a step; no step of the job has a Woodpecker form, so a no-op step stands in)
